content.title: About
content.content: XS Gold Plus is an energy drink containing caffeine, taurine, B‑vitamins and guarana extracts. It is designed to boost alertness, improve focus and accelerate metabolism. The drink has a bright gold color and a distinctive fruity‑citrus taste.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: XS Gold Plus was developed in Russia and has been produced since 2018.
It contains 200 mg of caffeine, equivalent to two espresso shots.
The formula includes electrolytes (sodium, potassium) to support fluid balance during exercise.
Packaging is a 250 ml aluminum can, fully recyclable.
The line offers several flavors, such as Tropical, Berry and Coffee.

items.title: Energy boost
items.content: Caffeine and taurine stimulate the central nervous system, increasing vigor and reducing perceived fatigue.

items.title: Improved concentration
items.content: B‑vitamins (B3, B5, B6, B12) support neurotransmitter synthesis, helping mental focus and reaction speed.

items.title: Metabolism support
items.content: Guarana provides natural caffeine that speeds up metabolic rate and aids calorie burning.

items.title: Electrolyte balance
items.content: Sodium and potassium help prevent dehydration during intense physical activity.

items.title: Antioxidant protection
items.content: Vitamin C and plant extracts have antioxidant properties that protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Excess caffeine intake
items.content: High caffeine doses may cause anxiety, insomnia, rapid heartbeat and increased blood pressure.

items.title: Not for children and pregnant women
items.content: Due to its high caffeine content, the product is not recommended for persons under 18, pregnant or nursing women.

items.title: Drug interactions
items.content: Caffeine can amplify the effects of certain stimulants and reduce the efficacy of sedatives.

items.title: Allergy to ingredients
items.content: The drink may contain trace amounts of gluten, soy or dairy, which should be considered by allergic individuals.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: Acidic flavorings may irritate the stomach lining if consumed frequently.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Consume one 250 ml can 30‑60 minutes before physical activity or when energy drops. Do not exceed 2–3 servings per day. Drink chilled and store in a cool place, away from direct sunlight.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep cans in a dry, cool place protected from direct sunlight. Once opened, finish within 24 hours. Do not store at temperatures above 30 °C.
